name: hushh-one-mcp
description: OpenClaw bundle for the Hussh One consent MCP, enabling agents to request explicit scoped access to a user's PKM through Hussh.

interface.shortDescription: Use Hussh One consented PKM access from OpenClaw.
interface.longDescription: Adds the Hussh One MCP bridge and agent guidance for searching dynamic PKM scopes, requesting user consent in One/Kai, polling consent status, and retrieving scoped encrypted exports.
defaultPrompt: Search a user's Hussh scopes before requesting consent.
Request One consent for a narrow PKM scope.
Check a Hussh consent request and fetch export metadata.
